description: Paid (Muro credits, needs a Muro API key). Repaint the walls in a photo of a room, facade or roof in 1 to 12 colours at once and return one image per colour. Give the photo as image_url (a public link) or image_base64. Give each colour as brand + name_or_code from the catalogue (e.g. "Farrow & Ball" + "Hague Blue") or as hex. Without a photo it paints Muro’s sample room (or facade, roof). Every colour comes with a shopping list: the closest real paints from several brands with ΔE and a verdict; pass country to put brands sold there first. RAL works as brand "RAL" + "9005" or just "RAL 9005". Waits up to about 45 seconds; if some colours are still being painted, it returns a job_id for get_visualization. Tell the user the cost before calling: 1 credit per colour in standard quality.

colors.description: 1 to 12 colours; each one is a separate painted image

hex.description: Colour as hex, e.g. "#3D4E57" (instead of brand + name_or_code)

label.description: Optional display name for a hex colour

name_or_code.description: Colour name or code in that brand, e.g. "Hague Blue" or "30"

country.description: Where the user buys paint, e.g. "PL", "DE", "US": brands sold there come first in the shopping list

image_base64.description: The photo as base64 or a data: URL, instead of image_url

image_url.description: Public link to the photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB). Leave out both image fields to paint Muro's sample room

match_brands.description: Only list paints from these brands, e.g. ["Dulux", "Śnieżka"]

matches.description: Paints to list per colour (default 5, 0 = no shopping list)

paint_ceiling.description: Interiors only: paint the ceiling too

quality.description: standard ≈1K (1 credit per colour), hd ≈2K (2), ultra ≈4K (3; plan permitting)

name: visualize_room
title: Paint a room photo
